title: 90-day focus map and skill pivot — scratchpad
content:
Purpose:
This is a personal scratchpad to run a focused 90-day stretch aimed at shifting my day-to-day from operational ticket triage into more strategic capability building: coaching managers, running small evals for hiring changes, and tightening our onboarding metrics. Use it for manager prep, evidence collection, and quick drafts for 1:1s / skip-levels.

Context (why now):
- Team is scaling (hiring plan +30% Q2), I want to be in a position to lead a micro-program for manager enablement rather than just handling individual escalations.
- Performance review cycle approaching (June) — need clear, quantifiable evidence of impact.
- There are recurring onboarding defects (time-to-first-PR, mentor handoff) that seem amenable to a small process pilot.

North star (end of 90 days):
- Launch a 6-week manager enablement pilot (10 managers) and document baseline->post improvements.
- Reduce average time-to-first-PR for new hires in eng to <= 12 days in pilot cohort.
- Move personal time allocation from 60% ticket work to 60% program/coaching work.

Top 3 objectives (90d):
1) Manager enablement pilot: curriculum, schedule, 10 managers enrolled, baseline survey and follow-up.
2) Onboarding process experiment: define 3 targeted interventions (mentor checklist, onboarding sprint template, first-week pairing windows), run with 8 new hires.
3) Skill pivot — evidence & coaching: get 5 direct coaching hours/week, practice facilitation, and run 2 micro-retros to iterate.

Success metrics (how I'll measure):
- Program: pilot completion rate >= 80%, average manager survey satisfaction >= 4.0/5, 70% report at least one change in their 1:1s after pilot.
- Onboarding: cohort median time-to-first-PR drops from baseline by 20% (target <= 12 days).
- Time allocation: weekly timesheets show <40% of time on operational tickets by week 10.
- Visibility: submit 1 concise exec update (one-pager) after pilot with quantitative outcomes.

Evidence snippets to collect (examples):
- Before/after survey snapshots (export CSVs).
- Slack thread excerpts where a manager applies a technique (save link + short summary).
- Time-tracked calendar blocks showing coaching sessions (screenshot + note).
- Onboarding repo activity: commit timestamps for new-hire PRs (link).

Weekly checkpoints (template):
Wk 1 (setup):
- Draft pilot curriculum (¶ topics + 30–45m practices).
- Identify 10 managers, get manager buy-in emails.
- Baseline manager survey + baseline onboarding metrics query (ask analytics).
- Block 6 coaching hours on calendar.

Wk 2–3 (launch & baseline):
- Run 1st workshop, collect feedback, adjust agenda.
- Start onboarding experiment with next new-hire batch (n=4).
- Capture early PR metrics and mentor handoff notes.

Wk 4–7 (iterate):
- Weekly micro-retros with managers (15m) to capture one change applied.
- Mid-pilot survey at week 4.
- Tweak onboarding interventions (mentor cadence, pairing windows).

Wk 8–12 (report & handoff):
- Final survey + compile quantitative results.
- One-pager for manager + exec audiences.
- Handoff plan to programs owner or embed into onboarding wiki.

Manager prep snippets (quick copy for 1:1s / skip-levels):
- 1-liner to open: “Quick check — in the last two weeks, what’s one thing you tried differently in 1:1s? What changed?”
- If they haven’t tried anything: “Would you be open to a tiny experiment next week? I can share a 10-minute script to try.”
- For impact update: “Small update — pilot managers are reporting a 30% uptick in direct reports raising blockers earlier; happy to share details if you want the one-pager.”

Evidence log (quick rows I copy/paste into a tracker):
- [DATE] | [TYPE] survey | [COHORT] | key stat or quote | link
- [DATE] | slack | manager X applied 'ask early' script | excerpt + link
- [DATE] | repo | new-hire Y first PR timestamp | link

Script fragments to use in meetings (raw):
- ‘‘When a direct report brings up a blocker, ask: ‘What’s stopping you from making a small experiment right now?’ Then set a 24–48h micro-task and check-in.’’
- ‘‘Try this 3-question 1:1 opener: wins? blockers? one ask for me to act on?’’

Risks and mitigations:
- Low manager engagement —> mitigate with 1:1 outreach, highlight peer examples, keep first session highly tactical.
- Data access lag for PR metrics —> pre-request queries from analytics and store weekly snapshots.
- Time bleed back to tickets —> protect PTAs: block 8am–10am program hours and mark as focus in calendar.

Open questions (to resolve quickly):
- Which analytics owner can give a time-series export for first-PR timestamps? (ASK: @analytics-team)
- Is there an existing micro-learning slot in L&D we can piggyback on? (ASK: @L&D)
- Legal/privacy check for storing screenshots of Slack — confirm acceptable redaction practice.

Action backlog (short):
- [ ] Draft pilot syllabus (modules + exercises) — owner: me — due Wk1 end.
- [ ] Send manager invite + invite note template — owner: me — due Wk1.
- [ ] Analytics query for onboarding PRs — owner: analytics — due Wk1.
- [ ] Create 1-page pilot update template for execs — owner: me — due Wk10.

Micro-habit tracker (daily prompts, 90-day cadence):
- Daily morning: 10-min planning (top 3 outcomes for the day).
- End of day: 5-min evidence note (what changed? one quote/action).
- Weekly: 30-min reflection on what to stop/start/continue.

Sample language for self-review bullets (short, measurable):
- “Designed and launched a 6-week manager enablement pilot for 10 managers; baseline->post survey showed average satisfaction 4.2/5 and 72% reported at least one changed practice in 1:1s.”
- “Reduced median time-to-first-PR for experimental onboarding cohort from 15 days to 11 days (27% improvement) by introducing scheduled pairing windows and mentor checklists.”
- “Shifted time allocation from reactive tickets to strategic programs (operational tickets reduced from ~60% to 35% of weekly focus by week 10).”

Quick notes to self (raw):
- Be ruthless with calendar hygiene — protecting program blocks is the single biggest lever.
- Use very short pre-reads — managers won’t read >2 pages.
- Capture one micro-quote per conversation; it’s unbelievably useful for storytelling.

Next immediate steps (today):
1) Draft the 4-module pilot syllabus (30–45m each) + 1 pager.
2) Ping analytics for PR exports (linked_artifacts: HR-1024).
3) Put tentative invites on 10 managers' calendars; mark RSVP as tentative.

Unresolved TODOs (carry over):
- Decide success threshold for ‘adoption’ (is 1 change in 1:1 enough?).
- Find 2 peer examples from other companies (ask Jin).
- Confirm whether we can include manager names in the post-pilot write-up.

-- end scratchpad --

(Short-term meta: keep this doc as a living journal — keep evidence snippets here until I move them to a structured tracker. Cull after the pilot into Confluence + attach exported CSVs.)
